title: De'longhi Nespresso Pixie En127.s Espresso Machine (Silver) | 19-Bar Pump, Heats in 25 Second, 0.7 L Water Tank, Auto Shut-Off 9 Minute, Under 1260 W, Compact Design
features: HIGH PERFORMANCE: With a 19-bar high-pressure pump and a fast heating system (just a few seconds), it offers easy entry, automatic opening and brewing of coffee capsules
COMPACT SIZE: With its award-winning compact design and user-friendly features, Pixie delivers delicious cups of coffee with minimal hassle
EASY TO USE: There are 2 programmable coffee selections with automatic flow stops to make Espresso and Lungo preparations
ENERGY SAVING: The machine will automatically turn off after 9 minutes of inactivity, and with a quick ignition time of 25 seconds, you can easily prepare your morning coffee in no time at all
COFFEE TYPES: Nespresso offers an extensive range of coffee to satisfy any taste of any time of day
